changes: Captured context_files now stores exact build/toolchain/license bytes and restores them separately from theorem source roles.
Expansion now restores sources, catalogs and context, reporting three separate counts.

Live verification checks exact source/catalog/context bytes and identities; a containing commit may change HEAD observation without breaking byte custody. CLI --live reports head_observation_changed; status exposes head_drift. Transaction capture/CAS still freezes and rereads HEAD.

Bindings preserve original declared hash/status/verification, per-binding freshness and full catalog snapshot bytes. Uncataloged/stale/catalog-only paths appear as metadata_findings without hash repair or proof promotion.
Context changes seed every source for dependency invalidation; source-only changes use exact reverse reachability in union of old/new graphs.
Import scanner now follows local pinned Lean Parser/Module/Syntax.lean: optional public/meta and all modifiers; explicit ordinary module imports only. Quoted modules fail closed.
verification_so_far: 19 hostile controls passed before added context/head-preservation controls; expanded suite running next.
limitations: Cache-writer lock serializes cooperating ref writers; source editors are not globally locked. Full source/catalog/context/HEAD readback immediately precedes ref replacement but is an observed consistency check, not a theorem about an atomic global source transaction.
External package bytes and .lake artifacts are excluded; dependency revision files are preserved, no cold dependency reconstruction claimed.
No real repository snapshot created by worker.
